examples.en: There are VR exhibitions, livestreaming classes and many other resources.
examples.zh: 那里有虚拟现实展览，直播课程和其他资源。

examples.en: 5G networks are about 10 times faster than 4G. This means you can download a movie in seconds using 5G. Also, VR games will become more popular with 5G. 5G will make the VR games even more real.
examples.zh: 5G 网络的速度大约是 4G 的10倍，这意味着你可以使用 5G 网络瞬间就能下载一部电影。此外，虚拟现实游戏将开始变得更受欢迎。5G 将使虚拟现实游戏更加真实。

examples.en: Because of VR technology, people can visit places of interest both at home and abroad instead of going there in person.
examples.zh: 由于虚拟现实技术，人们可以不用亲自拜访就能参观国内外的名胜古迹。
